title: Main Hoon Yodha
desc: Due to some unfortunate circumstances, a medical student follows the path of crime. Trouble ensues when he turns out to be a Good Samaritan, proving to be an enemy of the mafia.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.

title: Police Power
desc: A police officer tries to change his younger brother, who turns to a life of crime, but he fails. He then takes on the local gangster responsible for inciting youngsters towards crime.

title: Vajra Kavachadhara Govinda
desc: Govind, a petty thief who is down on his luck, sets out on a treasure hunt to help his villagers. However, he must overcome a challenge in order to retrieve the valuables from a temple.

title: Enemy
desc: Rajiv grows envious of his childhood friend, Chozhan, as he is better than him at most things. The frenemies grow apart only to meet under very different circumstances several years later.
